title: Gulping/Swallowing
desc: Omeprazole, Metoclopramide, Sucralfate, Prednisolone, Budesonide, Cyclosporine

meds.name: Metoclopramide
freqs: every 8–12 hours, 30 minutes before a meal

meds.name: Carafate (if needed)
meds.doseText: ½ to 1 tablet (1 g tablets) as a water slurry

notes: Give as slurry on empty stomacy an hour or more apart from meals or other meds.
If IBS. Pred, budesonide, cyclosporine 5 mg/kg SID
The video looks a LOT like reflux esophagitis, so I'd try those maneuvers:
-Omeprazole: 30 mg BID, each dose 30 min before a meal (or if this is worse at night, give the second dose at BEDtime, not dinnertime)
-Metoclopramide: 10 mg BID-TID, each dose 30 min before a meal and again at bedtime
...after the bedtime meds, give her a small meal 30 min later and then it really IS time for bed
If this is the right idea, it works immediately....so usually within a week you'll know whether you're interrupting the pattern (depending on how frequently these episodes happen).
